trip.name: Venice + Dolomites 2026
trip.summary: Venice 1.5 days → Target Rent pickup near VCE at noon → Noventa di Piave outlet through dinner and closing → late arrival in Cortina → east Dolomites → scenic transfer → Ortisei west base through the final night → early direct drive to Target Rent and VCE on flight day

metadata.difficulty: light-medium with one conditional easy via ferrata
metadata.viaFerrataPolicy: Ra Bujela only with suitable prior experience or a guide, full EN 958 equipment, dry conditions and confirmed lift operation

places.name: Venice Marco Polo Airport (VCE)
places.address: Viale Galileo Galilei 30, 30173 Venezia VE, Italy
places.notes: Arrival 9 Sep; Target Rent shuttle meeting point on 11 Sep; airport arrival after car return and departure on 25 Sep.

places.name: a&o Venezia Mestre
places.address: Via Ca Marcello, 15, 30172 Venezia VE, Italy
places.notes: לינה מאושרת לשני לילות; לעדכן מראש על הגעה מאוחרת.

places.name: Piazza San Marco
places.address: P.za San Marco, 30100 Venezia VE, Italy

places.name: Affordable Venetian mask shop — verify exact shop
places.notes: Do not substitute an expensive artisan workshop. Resolve one specific well-reviewed budget shop in Chrome before the day.

places.name: Target Rent — Venice Airport
places.notes: Off-airport Target Rent office, open daily 08:00–19:00 with 24-hour shuttle service. From VCE use the free Park Gold shuttle from the P5 shuttle area. Keep the booked 11 Sep pickup at 12:00. For return, arrive around 08:45 for the booked 09:00 slot, then use the shuttle back to the terminal.

places.name: Designer Outlet Noventa di Piave
places.address: Via Marco Polo, 1, 30020 Noventa di Piave VE, Italy
places.notes: Friday opening hours 10:00–20:00. On 11 Sep arrive after the 12:00 car pickup, have lunch, shop, complete tax-free paperwork and eat dinner before leaving at closing for Cortina. A4/E70 and A27 route includes tolls.

places.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
places.notes: East-Dolomites base. Official forecast: https://meteo.arpa.veneto.it/meteo/bollettini/it/pdf/meteo_dolomiti.pdf . Live Tofana/Duca d'Aosta webcams: https://www.impianticortina.it/en/web-cams-weather/

places.name: Snow Service Cortina
places.address: Via Guglielmo Marconi 12/C, 32043 Cortina d'Ampezzo BL, Italy
places.notes: 1–17 Sep opening hours: 08:30–12:30 and 14:30–19:00. Call ahead to reserve two complete EN 958 via-ferrata sets for fitting at opening on 12 Sep; confirm the cancellation/payment policy and whether the sets may be retained for the 13 Sep weather backup.

places.name: Piè Tofana – Duca d'Aosta chairlift
places.notes: Summer 2026 operation ends 13 Sep. Daily hours 08:30–17:00. Adult return €18. This is the time-critical access lift for Ra Bujela. Live webcam/weather: https://www.impianticortina.it/en/web-cams-weather/ . Official Dolomites bulletin: https://meteo.arpa.veneto.it/meteo/bollettini/it/pdf/meteo_dolomiti.pdf

places.name: Rifugio Duca d'Aosta
places.notes: Start/finish and support point for Ra Bujela. The official 1h45 route time is hut-to-hut; reserve 3h for a calm beginner-paced outing including approach, instruction/checks, waiting and descent back to the hut. Confirm meal service shortly before the day and carry a packed fallback.

places.name: Lago di Centro Cadore (Pieve di Cadore)
places.notes: הוסר ממסלול החזרה כדי להשאיר את הלילה האחרון ב-Ortisei ולהחזיר את הרכב ביום הטיסה. נשמר כרעיון במפה בלבד.

places.name: Rifugio Auronzo / Tre Cime parking
places.notes: 2026 car parking €40, mandatory online reservation, 12-hour ticket; booking expected to open around end of April.

places.name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop
places.notes: Plan 10 km / 4–5 h. Arrive 07:30–08:00. Carry sandwiches; do not rely on rifugi.

places.name: Lago di Misurina
places.notes: Easy lake stop. Use the official ARPAV Dolomites bulletin: https://meteo.arpa.veneto.it/meteo/bollettini/it/pdf/meteo_dolomiti.pdf

places.name: Lago Pianozes
places.notes: Short, no-ascent lakeside viewpoint after Ra Bujela; do not turn it into the longer walking loop. Official regional forecast: https://meteo.arpa.veneto.it/meteo/bollettini/it/pdf/meteo_dolomiti.pdf

places.name: P1 – Parcheggio Lago di Braies
places.notes: Road regulation and reserved limited parking apply during the September 2026 visit. Official local weather: https://weather.province.bz.it/en/home (select Braies/Prags).

places.name: La Palafitta – Lago di Braies boathouse
places.notes: 7–27 Sep 2026: 09:00–17:30; shared boat ride shown as €20 / 45 min.

places.name: 5 Torri chairlift – Bai de Dones
places.notes: 5 Torri chairlift currently published through 11 Oct 2026, 09:00–17:00, weather dependent. Official webcam: https://5torri.it/EN/p34-Webcam . Official regional forecast: https://meteo.arpa.veneto.it/meteo/bollettini/it/pdf/meteo_dolomiti.pdf

places.name: Funivia Lagazuoi
places.notes: Published 2026 operation: 6 Jun–18 Oct; first lift 09:00, last uphill 16:40, last descent 17:00. Official regional forecast: https://meteo.arpa.veneto.it/meteo/bollettini/it/pdf/meteo_dolomiti.pdf

places.name: Ortisei
places.notes: West-Dolomites base. Official South Tyrol forecast: https://weather.province.bz.it/en/home . Official Dolomites mountain bulletin: https://static-weather.province.bz.it/web-data/pdf-forecast/mountain_bulletin_dolomites_en.pdf

places.name: Seceda cable car – Ortisei
places.notes: Published 2026 operation: 22 May–2 Nov. On 18 Sep the Ortisei–Furnes and Furnes–Seceda lifts run 08:30–17:30. The optional Fermeda chairlift runs only through 20 Sep, 09:30–16:30. Official mountain weather: https://weather.province.bz.it/en/forecasts

places.name: Mont Sëuc / Alpe di Siusi cable car – Ortisei
places.notes: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola operates 1 May–2 Nov 2026; on 19 Sep the published hours are 08:30–18:00. Verify live status the evening before. Official mountain weather: https://weather.province.bz.it/en/forecasts

places.name: Chiesa di Santa Maddalena – Val di Funes
Parcheggio Malga Zannes (P1)
places.notes: Verify and reserve parking online when the 2026 date is released.

itinerary.title: Arrival at VCE — LY 289
itinerary.description: Use the existing protected calendar flight. Times here are Europe/Rome local time; do not recreate or modify the flight event.

itinerary.title: VCE → Mestre lodging
itinerary.description: Airport transfer, late check-in, water and a light snack. Keep the first night car-free.

itinerary.title: Check-in — a&o Venezia Mestre
itinerary.description: Confirmed two-night stay for two adults. Expected arrival is after the flight and airport transfer; notify the property about late arrival if required.

itinerary.title: San Marco and central Venice
itinerary.description: Early train/bus into Venice; Piazza San Marco, exterior landmarks and a slow walk before crowds peak.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Venice
itinerary.description: Reserve or choose a simple bacaro away from the most tourist-heavy frontage.

itinerary.title: Affordable Venetian mask shop
itinerary.description: Buy only after confirming the exact budget shop in Chrome; avoid an unplanned premium artisan purchase.

itinerary.title: Murano afternoon
itinerary.description: Vaporetto to Murano, short island walk and return before a late dinner. Drop if transit or weather is poor.

metadata.fallback: Stay in Cannaregio and return to Mestre early.

itinerary.title: Rialto and final Venice walk
itinerary.description: Early Rialto area walk and coffee. Keep the original Venice anchor, then return promptly to Mestre for luggage and checkout.

itinerary.title: Return to Mestre, checkout and transfer to VCE
itinerary.description: Return from Venice, collect luggage, check out and travel to VCE. Lunch is moved to the outlet so the 12:00 Target Rent pickup remains realistic.

itinerary.title: VCE arrivals → Target Rent by shuttle
itinerary.description: Reach the P5 shuttle area and request the free Park Gold shuttle to the off-airport Target Rent office.

itinerary.title: Rental-car pickup — Target Rent
itinerary.description: Keep the booked noon pickup. Inspect and photograph the car, confirm fuel/deposit/toll rules and load offline maps.

itinerary.title: Target Rent → Designer Outlet Noventa di Piave
itinerary.description: Allow about 35 minutes plus the A4/E70 toll and parking.

itinerary.title: Designer Outlet Noventa di Piave — lunch, shopping and dinner
itinerary.description: 13:35 lunch; about 14:20–18:30 shopping and tax-free paperwork; 18:30–19:45 dinner. The outlet closes at 20:00, which is the planned departure time.

itinerary.title: Designer Outlet Noventa di Piave → Cortina
itinerary.description: The normal drive is about 2h11 for roughly 161 km; allow 2h30 via A27/SS51. Arrange late or self check-in before the trip.

itinerary.title: Breakfast and preliminary Ra Bujela go/no-go
itinerary.description: Check the official ARPAV Dolomites bulletin, Duca d'Aosta webcam, thunderstorm timing, wind and live lift status. If clearly unsafe, do not rent the equipment; use 13 Sep as the final lift-supported backup.

itinerary.title: Snow Service fitting and final go/no-go
itinerary.description: At opening, fit two pre-reserved complete sets: helmet, harness and EN 958 energy-absorbing lanyard. Make the final go/no-go only after the current webcam/lift check and the shop fitting; if no-go, confirm whether to retain or re-rent for 13 Sep.

itinerary.title: Drive to Piè Tofana
itinerary.description: Park at the Piè Tofana–Duca d'Aosta chairlift. The later start is deliberate because the equipment is collected that morning.

itinerary.title: Piè Tofana → Rifugio Duca d'Aosta
itinerary.description: Published summer 2026 hours are 08:30–17:00; adult return fare €18.

itinerary.title: Via ferrata Ra Bujela — conservative 3-hour block
itinerary.description: The official hut-to-hut route time is 1h45. Reserve 3h from Duca d'Aosta back to Duca d'Aosta for mutual checks, the short approach, instruction/hesitation, queues, a calm pace and the descent. Do not combine with Ra Pegna. The first vertical section and the exposed corner after the two bridges require particular care.

metadata.officialTime: 1h45, start and finish at Rifugio Duca d'Aosta
metadata.difficulty: Officially easy, but exposed and vertical in places.
metadata.requirements: Suitable prior via-ferrata experience or a guide; full EN 958 kit; dry cable; no rain, thunderstorm or strong wind.

itinerary.title: Lunch and recovery — Rifugio Duca d'Aosta
itinerary.description: Confirm kitchen service shortly before the day and carry a packed backup. If the route runs beyond 13:15, shorten the lake stop rather than the safety margin.

itinerary.title: Chairlift descent and return to the car
itinerary.description: Descend with more than two hours of margin before the published 17:00 final service.

itinerary.title: Drive — Piè Tofana → Lago Pianozes
itinerary.description: Use the nearby lake instead of duplicating the longer Misurina stop planned for 14 Sep. Go only if the route finished on time and both travelers feel good.

itinerary.title: Lago Pianozes — short no-ascent viewpoint
itinerary.description: Drive close to the lake and take only a short lakeside pause; do not follow the longer walking loop. If weather or energy is poor, replace this with a Corso Italia walk in Cortina.

itinerary.title: Return to Cortina
itinerary.description: Return directly for the equipment hand-back. If the ferrata ran late, skip Pianozes and use this time for an easy town walk instead.

itinerary.title: Return equipment and easy Corso Italia walk
itinerary.description: Return the equipment after a successful outing, then take an easy central Cortina walk. If 12 Sep was a no-go, retain the equipment only under the shop's agreed 13 Sep backup terms.

itinerary.title: Hard Ra Bujela weather buffer / Lagazuoi if complete
itinerary.description: If Ra Bujela did not run on 12 Sep and conditions are safe, repeat the Ra Bujela morning now; this is the final lift-supported chance because Piè Tofana closes after today. If Ra Bujela is complete, use the morning for Lagazuoi instead. If conditions are unsafe again, cancel the via ferrata.

metadata.finalDeadline: Piè Tofana summer operation ends after 13 Sep 2026.
metadata.fallback: Cortina, Passo Falzarego or another low-risk valley activity.

itinerary.title: Flexible lunch after the weather decision
itinerary.description: Eat near Duca d'Aosta/Falzarego/Cortina according to the chosen morning and carry a packed fallback.

itinerary.title: Equipment return and recovery
itinerary.description: Return the via-ferrata equipment if it was retained for the backup. Keep the remainder of the afternoon easy before Tre Cime.

itinerary.title: Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop
itinerary.description: Arrive at Rifugio Auronzo parking by 07:30–08:00. Light-medium 10 km loop, 4–5 hours; carry layers, water and sandwiches.

itinerary.title: Packed lunch on the Tre Cime route
itinerary.description: Eat the packed lunch when the route and weather allow; do not rely on rifugi service.

itinerary.title: Lago di Misurina recovery stop
itinerary.description: Optional easy lakeside recovery stop; skip if the hike runs late or weather worsens.

itinerary.title: Lago di Braies: boat and loop
itinerary.description: Use reserved parking, arrive early, take a 45-minute shared boat if operating, then complete the easy lake loop.

metadata.fallback: Dobbiaco and San Candido easy town day

itinerary.title: Lunch near Braies/Dobbiaco
itinerary.description: Choose a reserved or low-friction lunch after leaving the lakeshore crowd.

itinerary.title: Dobbiaco or Cortina recovery afternoon
itinerary.description: Easy café/town time, laundry and a weather check for the final east-base flex day.

itinerary.title: Cinque Torri weather and lift check
itinerary.description: Check ARPAV, the 5 Torri webcam and current lift status. Cinque Torri is the fixed Plan A anchor for today, not a leftover from 12 Sep.

itinerary.title: Drive — Cortina → Bai de Dones
itinerary.description: Park and be ready for the 09:00 opening of the 5 Torri chairlift.

itinerary.title: Cinque Torri — lift, trenches and viewpoints
itinerary.description: Take the chairlift, follow the easy M5a/M5b First World War museum paths and viewpoints near Rifugio Scoiattoli, and keep the total walking block to about 2h30. The chairlift is published to operate 09:00–17:00 on this date.

itinerary.title: Lunch near Cinque Torri
itinerary.description: Prefer Rifugio Scoiattoli if operating, or use the existing Averau option; confirm service and carry a snack fallback.

itinerary.title: 5 Torri chairlift descent
itinerary.description: Descend early, with a wide margin before the final 17:00 service.

itinerary.title: Passo Giau or Cortina recovery stop
itinerary.description: Short viewpoint stop only in clear conditions; otherwise return directly to Cortina.

itinerary.title: Laundry, fuel and pack for transfer
itinerary.description: Refuel, organize the car and download the next day’s scenic route offline.

itinerary.title: Scenic transfer Cortina → Ortisei
itinerary.description: Drive the scenic pass route only if weather and roads are good; otherwise use the safer direct route.

itinerary.title: Transfer-day lunch
itinerary.description: Stop where parking is simple; avoid a fixed mountain reservation that could pressure the drive.

itinerary.title: Ortisei check-in and orientation
itinerary.description: Check in, locate both lift stations, buy groceries and verify guest-card transport benefits.

itinerary.title: Seceda ridge morning
itinerary.description: Take the first practical lift from Ortisei and follow a light-medium ridge walk, turning back early if cloud builds.

metadata.fallback: Ortisei village and Val Gardena museum

itinerary.title: Lunch on/under Seceda
itinerary.description: Choose a hut with confirmed service or descend for lunch in Ortisei.

itinerary.title: Ortisei recovery afternoon
itinerary.description: No second mountain anchor; rest and review the next day’s operating notice.

itinerary.title: Alpe di Siusi from Ortisei
itinerary.description: Use the Ortisei cable car for a broad meadow walk with an easy turnaround and weather-aware pacing.

itinerary.title: Lunch on Alpe di Siusi
itinerary.description: Preselect one hut and keep a packed backup in case of closure or queues.

itinerary.title: Easy return and rest
itinerary.description: Return without adding another hike; use the afternoon for recovery.

itinerary.title: Val di Funes and Santa Maddalena
itinerary.description: Scenic village walk and church viewpoints; continue to Zannes only if parking is confirmed.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Val di Funes
itinerary.description: Choose a valley restaurant with parking; retain flexibility around the scenic stops.

itinerary.title: Zannes easy loop (optional)
itinerary.description: Only a short easy loop; skip if the morning was long or parking is unavailable.

itinerary.title: West-base weather buffer
itinerary.description: Repeat the highest-priority west anchor missed due to weather; otherwise take a gentle local walk.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Ortisei
itinerary.description: Flexible lunch after the buffer activity.

itinerary.title: Free afternoon
itinerary.description: Rest, café, crafts or laundry; intentionally unscheduled for resilience.

itinerary.title: Passo Gardena scenic morning
itinerary.description: Weather-dependent scenic drive with short viewpoints, not a major exposed hike.

itinerary.title: Lunch in Val Gardena
itinerary.description: Lunch in Selva/Santa Cristina with simple parking.

itinerary.title: Optional Vallunga easy walk
itinerary.description: Flat recovery walk only if energy and weather are good.

itinerary.title: Final Dolomites flex morning
itinerary.description: Use for a missed Plan A anchor or keep as a relaxed Ortisei morning; no forced checklist completion.

itinerary.title: Farewell lunch in Ortisei
itinerary.description: Book a pleasant but cancellable final-base lunch.

itinerary.title: Free afternoon and light organization
itinerary.description: Laundry, café or rest. Keep the main packing and flight-day preparation for the following afternoon; there is no checkout on 24 September.

itinerary.title: Final relaxed Dolomites morning
itinerary.description: Stay in the Ortisei/Val Gardena touring area for a relaxed local walk, a missed easy anchor or café time. Do not start a long or exposed hike.

metadata.fallback: Rest in Ortisei and keep the day light.

itinerary.title: Final lunch in Ortisei
itinerary.description: Choose a pleasant local lunch near the lodging and keep the afternoon free for flight-day preparation.

itinerary.title: Pack, fuel and prepare the early route
itinerary.description: Pack completely, refuel, check the Target Rent return instructions and shuttle process, download the direct route and arrange an early checkout.

itinerary.title: Early dinner and final night in Ortisei
itinerary.description: Remain at the west-base lodging for the final night, eat early and sleep early before the 04:30 wake-up. No Mestre overnight and no return-lake detour.

itinerary.title: Early wake-up and checkout
itinerary.description: Wake at 04:30, complete the pre-arranged early checkout, load the car and leave no later than 05:00.

itinerary.title: Direct drive — Ortisei → Target Rent
itinerary.description: Drive directly toward Target Rent at Via Orlanda 216. The working route is about 200 km and published estimates vary from roughly 2h45 to 3h20; this block uses the conservative end of that range.

itinerary.title: Final fuel and return buffer
itinerary.description: Top up fuel if the contract requires it, inspect the car and aim to reach Target Rent at about 08:45 for the 09:00 return.

itinerary.title: Return rental car — Target Rent
itinerary.description: Booked return is 09:00. Photograph the car, record fuel level and mileage, obtain the return receipt and move promptly to the free airport shuttle.

itinerary.title: Target Rent shuttle → VCE
itinerary.description: Use the free Target Rent/Park Gold shuttle and plan to reach the airport between 09:15 and 09:30, leaving about 2h35–2h50 before departure.

itinerary.title: Departure from VCE — LY 290
itinerary.description: Use the existing protected calendar flight. Times here are Europe/Rome local time; do not recreate or modify the flight event.
